title: mri_surf2volseg
description: Tool that cleans up presurf aseg cortex and WM, maps cortical labels from an annotation into a volume, and labels cerebral WM with closest cortical label.

source_segmentation.description: Source subcortical volume segmentation file (instead of using subcortical segs in input segmentation).
source_segmentation.title: Source segmentation file

lh_cortex_mask.description: Mask for left hemisphere cortex (usually lh.cortex.label).
lh_cortex_mask.title: Left hemisphere cortex mask

rh_cortex_mask.description: Mask for right hemisphere cortex (usually rh.cortex.label).
rh_cortex_mask.title: Right hemisphere cortex mask

fix_presurf_ribbon.description: Fix the cortical and WM labels in the input segmentation using ribbon file.
fix_presurf_ribbon.title: Fix cortical and WM labels with ribbon

label_cortex.description: Relabel cortex in the input segmentation with surface annotation.
label_cortex.title: Label cortex flag

label_wm.description: Relabel cerebral WM in the input segmentation with surface annotation.
label_wm.title: Label WM flag

label_wm_unknown.description: Relabel unknown WM as lhval and rhval (default is 5001 and 5002).
label_wm_unknown.title: Label unknown WM values

wmparc_dmax.description: Max distance (mm) from cortex to be labeled as gyral WM.
wmparc_dmax.title: WMPARC max distance

rip_unknown.description: Do not label WM based on 'unknown' cortical label.
rip_unknown.title: Rip unknown WM flag

hypo_as_wm.description: Label hypointensities as WM (when fixing with ribbon).
hypo_as_wm.title: Hypointensities as WM flag

nhops.description: Number of surface hops when searching for a nearby annotation.
nhops.title: Number of hops

help_flag.description: Print out information on how to use this program.
help_flag.title: Help flag

crs_test.description: Test labeling of only the voxel given by column, row, slice (debugging).
crs_test.title: CRS test coordinates

ctab_file.description: Embed color table in the output.
ctab_file.title: Color table file

threads_number.description: Run in parallel with the specified number of threads.
threads_number.title: Number of threads
